haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes from write (Option A). If unclaimed, it lapses at expires_at and stock frees then; the sweep only tidies.
haiku-low.q2: Reserved before charging. If one line is short, Inventory reserves nothing, Order rejects with REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, shows short items, no charge.
haiku-low.q3: Charge row is PENDING, unique on order id; retries return stored state, and the provider key is order id. Never a second charge.
haiku-low.q4: Claim fails. Order sets CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and emails the customer once. Payment refunds in full; settlement stays OPEN until REFUNDED.
haiku-low.q5: Only on the OrderConfirmed event, handled by the Cart service. On checkout failure, the cart is unchanged.
haiku-low.q6: The Order service moves the checkout; its orders store holds status and settlement for each order.
haiku-low.q7: Provider webhook, or Payment's poll at 35 min. Payment updates the charge and its outbox emits PaymentSucceeded or PaymentDeclined to Order.
haiku-low.q8: Payment stores each webhook event id under a unique constraint, and repeats return 200 unchanged. Order treats redelivered events as no-ops; updates are conditional.
haiku-low.q9: The PaymentDeclined event triggers it: Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED and sends release; Inventory sets HELD to RELEASED.
haiku-low.q10: The claim decides. A claim fails once the hold has lapsed, so Order cancels and Payment refunds in full. Option A applies.
haiku-low.q11: REFUND_FAILED: store error, attempts plus one. Under 8 attempts, back off and retry with same key; at 8, REFUND_ESCALATED. Tracked in Payment's refunds row.
haiku-low.q12: Order's OrderConfirmed event, via outbox, empties the cart in the Cart service. Only that event empties it.

sonnet.q1: Held 10 minutes from write (expires_at = now + 10 min). If not claimed, stock is free at expires_at; the minute sweep later sets it to RELEASED (tidy only). A later claim gets 'lapsed'.
sonnet.q2: Reserved before charging (charge only after AWAITING_PAYMENT following a successful reserve). If any line is short, Inventory reserves nothing, replies with the short items, and the order becomes REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK with no charge and the short items shown to the customer.
sonnet.q3: Charge is keyed by order id: Payment inserts a charge PENDING row unique on order id, so a retry returns the stored state and never a second charge; the provider call also uses Idempotency-Key = order id. Reconciliation re-sends with the same key only if the provider has no such charge.
sonnet.q4: The late success makes the claim fail ('lapsed'); the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK (settlement OPEN), OrderCancelled is emitted, the customer gets a sold-out email once, and Payment refunds the customer in full. Settlement becomes SETTLED once the refund is REFUNDED.
sonnet.q5: The cart is emptied only on the OrderConfirmed event (Cart service). On any failure or non-confirmed ending (rejected, checkout failed, declined, cancelled) the cart is unchanged.
sonnet.q6: No single orchestrator is named. Order service drives the steps via HTTP calls and events (outbox events between services). The record of progress is the order's status and settlement fields stored in the Order service (orders table), with Payment holding charge/refund state and Inventory the reservation state.
sonnet.q7: Provider sends a webhook (or Payment polls/reconciles) to Payment service, which does a conditional update on the charge and writes a PaymentSucceeded/PaymentDeclined outbox event in the same transaction; that broker event is delivered to the Order service, which finishes the order.
sonnet.q8: Webhooks: Payment stores each event id under a unique constraint and returns 200 with no change for duplicates; outcome changes are conditional updates (once; same-outcome repeat is a no-op). Order checks status is AWAITING_PAYMENT and otherwise no-ops on redelivered events; consumers are idempotent (processed event ids).
sonnet.q9: On PaymentDeclined event, Order sets PAYMENT_DECLINED, tells the customer, and sends an HTTP release (key = order id) to Inventory, retried with backoff until acknowledged or the release window ends. Inventory sets HELD to RELEASED. If unacknowledged, Order on-call is alerted and stock is freed anyway at expires_at.
sonnet.q10: Order sends a claim to Inventory after PaymentSucceeded. If the reservation is still HELD and unexpired (or already CLAIMED), the claim succeeds and the order is CONFIRMED; otherwise Inventory replies lapsed and the order is cancelled and refunded in full. Under Option A, after UNRESOLVED the claim always fails.
sonnet.q11: Refund becomes REFUND_FAILED with error stored and attempts + 1. If attempts are below 8, wait with exponential backoff and re-send with the same key; at 8 it becomes REFUND_ESCALATED, ops alerted, open until ops resolves. Pending refund is tracked in the Payment service's refunds table (unique on order id, with state, attempts, last error), and polled at 35 min then every 15 min.
sonnet.q12: The OrderConfirmed event (emitted via Order's outbox when status becomes CONFIRMED) causes the Cart service to empty the cart; Cart records processed event ids for idempotency.
